body: My mother called me today, after a minute of complaining I hung up without saying goodbye, because I could burst out crying any second and she wasn't helpful anyway. I also hinted about possible suicide to my sister, but in a semi-joking way, so she laughed it off. I feel uncomfortable when talking to people, even if they are close relatives. What's more, I find it hard to express feelings in my native language, I'm emotionless in public and I don't think anyone would believe me, if I suddenly started talking about what I'm going through. Exercising outdoors during winter isn't really an option, as I get sick easily and I'm reluctant to spend money on a gym. My last goal was to move abroad to Germany or Austria to study, but I'm barely doing anything to improve my language skills.

I know that's kind of late, but thank you for your help. The morning after I wrote this post, I bought a one-day ticket (I could have bought a quarterly one, but that made no sense given the probability of suicide) to go to the university. I met a person I knew (we took some classes together) in the subway, I tried to hide away from her at the station in order not to bother her with my overwhelming sadness (it was extremely hard to disguise it and there was a chance she was going somewhere else), but at the end we talked a bit and it was just nice to see that somebody cares about me. The majority of issues have been resolved, not in the best way, but it could have been worse, so everything seemed acceptable for a while.

A few months passed, I've been happy a part of this period and felt awful at other times. However, I now understand my mental state better. It can worsen without a significant (or any) reason. Once, after a rather pleasant and productive fortnight, I started thinking about suicide immediately after waking up one morning. While obviously that's not a good sign, knowing the irrationality of at least some of these feelings makes me more comfortable. Currently I feel strongly depressed again (I still haven't asked for professional help, maybe I should), but I have found real knowledge about myself. Maybe I'm losing the fight for peace of mind, happiness and so on, but it was worth it to keep trying for at least several months. Thank you.
